question: I'm visiting a food and beverage plant. Which products should I pitch for washdown environments and why?
answer: For food and beverage washdown environments, pitch Warner Electric's Washdown Electro Pack Clutch/Brakes (EPW) and the Enclosed Unimodule Washdown (EUM-W) series. Both are totally enclosed in smooth, completely sealed, rugged enclosures that keep wear particles in and contaminants out, with an IP67 washdown rating and stainless steel construction. For caustic washdown applications such as meat and poultry, pitch the all stainless steel clutches and brakes, which feature stainless steel bearings and housing and are designed to run 24/7.

question: What is the washdown rating and enclosure material of the Enclosed Unimodule Washdown clutch/brake?
answer: The Enclosed Unimodule Washdown (EUM-W) clutch/brake has a washdown rating of IP67 and a stainless steel enclosure material.

question: What is the Warner Electric magnetic capping headset's key differentiator I can mention to a beverage customer?
answer: Warner Electric magnetic capping headsets feature constant Smooth Torque Technology. This differs from most competitor OEM headsets that use two opposing magnets, which causes pulsating torque. The pounding effect of a pulsating clutch increases cap tightness during the capping process, so the Smooth Torque design gives more consistent capping.

question: A dairy customer needs an emergency stop along their conveyor. What can I offer and how far does it reach?
answer: Offer the SR cable pull switch. It is designed to give personnel ready access to a machine stop switch up to 245 feet away by simply pulling on the cable. It is ideal for use along conveyors or on the perimeter of a packaging assembly. The machine stops when the cable is pulled or when the cable breaks, and it cannot restart until the switch is reset.

question: For a crane and hoist customer who needs power-off load holding, what should I pitch?
answer: Pitch Warner Electric's ERD electrically released brakes. They provide a reliable, cost-effective solution for power-off load holding and are ideal for dynamic stopping when power is lost. They deliver heavy-duty braking with no residual torque in the disengaged position and are suited to dry environments. They apply across chain and wire rope hoists, gantry cranes, monorail lifting systems, steel mill cranes, traveling bridge cranes, and top slewing lifting cranes.

question: What is the CBCx-001 switch and where does it fit in crane applications?
answer: The CBCx-001 is a power supply AC rectifier with programmable over-excitation voltage and an integrated On/Off switch. It is ideal for elevator brakes and ERD/ERS brakes. It can switch between full bridge and single wave rectification, is controlled by an external PLC or board, and enables quick engagement for security applications. In cranes it is used on jib workshop cranes and truck-mounted and crawler cranes.

question: Where does the EUM-FBB brake module mount and how many sizes are available?
answer: The EUM-FBB Series Electrically Released Brake Module is used in brake-only applications and mounts between a C-face motor and a gear box or reducer. It is available in four sizes.

question: What is the torque and horsepower range of Warner Electric's basic clutches and brakes for packaging machinery?
answer: Warner Electric basic clutches and brakes have a torque capacity range from 5 lb-in to 1300 lb-ft, with horsepower capability up to 100 HP. They are user-assembled from standard components for optimum performance in the smallest possible package size.

question: A packaging customer runs unwind and rewind tension control with flying splices. What should I pitch?
answer: Pitch Warner Electric's Tension Brakes and Controls. This is a comprehensive line of tension control products including electric and pneumatic friction brakes, magnetic particle and permanent magnet brakes, and both analog and digital controls. Several brake types are specifically designed for unwind/rewind/tension applications to provide consistent tension, even during flying splices and emergency stops.

question: What does Warner Electric offer for palletizing in packaging lines?
answer: For palletizing, Warner Electric offers its line of electrically released, dynamic, spring-set brakes (ERS). These offer a high-performance, cost-effective solution for power-off load holding applications and will hold the full weight of the load when electrical power is accidentally or intentionally removed. They can be applied in any dry environment requiring dependable heavy-duty braking with no residual torque in the disengaged position.

question: How should I introduce NSK to a machine tools customer? Give me the background.
answer: NSK Ltd. (Nippon Seiko Kabushiki-gaisha) is a Japanese multinational and the largest bearing manufacturer in Japan, with 104 years of history. They are world leaders with more than 27% market share for CNC and machine tool ball screws. NSK produces bearings such as super precision and SPACEA bearings, precision machinery and parts like linear guides and ball screws, and automotive bearings and components.

question: What are the rail width and load capacity ranges of the NSK Square Type Roller Linear Guide?
answer: The NSK Square Type Roller Linear Guide has a rail width from 15 mm to 65 mm, an assembly height from 28 mm to 90 mm, a dynamic load from 10300 N to 288000 N, and a static load from 27500 N to 756000 N.

question: Brief me on the NSK SPACEA Series before I meet a pharmaceutical customer.
answer: NSK's SPACEA Series bearings are designed for special environments, with product variations applicable to vacuum, corrosive, clean, sanitary, high-temperature, dust-contaminated, and non-magnetic requirements. They offer high quality and high performance in severe operating environments. They cater to the food and pharmaceutical industries, with applications including food processing machinery and pharmaceutical manufacturing equipment.

question: What is the operating temperature range of NSK Grease LR3?
answer: NSK Grease LR3 has a temperature range of -30 degrees C to 130 degrees C. It contains a special synthetic oil for high temperature and stability and dramatically increases lubrication life under high temperature conditions.

question: What are the body diameter and mass of the NSK Hand Grease Pump, and how many nozzles does it include?
answer: The NSK Hand Grease Pump has a body diameter of 38.1 mm and a mass of 240 g. It is lightweight and leakproof, and it comes with 5 different nozzle attachments.

question: Which industries and applications use the NSK Ball Linear Guide?
answer: The NSK Ball Linear Guide is used across many industries including packaging equipment, material handling equipment, electronic part manufacturing, industrial robots, woodworking machines, laser cutting machines, electric discharge machines, medical equipment, printing equipment, LCD manufacturing equipment, and PCB-drilling machines. Applications include laser cutting machines and material handling equipment.

question: Give me Winkel's company background for a heavy material handling customer.
answer: Winkel GmbH is a Germany-based company currently managed by Mr. Christian Winkel. It has served the industry for more than 38 years in linear systems and material handling. Winkel is a market leader in heavy load linear lifting systems and has delivered thousands of material handling systems. It also manufactures combined bearings and U-shaped profiles widely used in material handling systems for vertical or horizontal movement.

question: What is the working temperature and load capacity of WINKEL Combined Bearings (axial bearing fixed)?
answer: WINKEL Combined Bearings (axial bearing fixed) have a working temperature of -20 degrees C up to +80 degrees C. They are based on full complement cylindrical rollers and lubricated with grade 3 grease (for example Shell Gadus S2 V100 3). The radial bearing load capacity ranges from 5.23 kN to 59.20 kN and the axial bearing load capacity from 1.68 kN to 18.50 kN.

question: What material and standard lengths does the Winkel Standard U Profile come in?
answer: The Winkel Standard U-shaped profiles are made from high quality hot rolled steel S450 J2 Mod. in a sandblasted version, suitable for Winkel bearings. The standard lengths are 6 metres or 12 metres, and standard profiles are straightened to plus or minus 1.0 mm/m. The inner width ranges from 40.5 mm to 88.4 mm and the outer width from 86.7 mm to 185.1 mm.

question: Which industries and machines does Winkel serve that I can reference in a steel plant pitch?
answer: Winkel serves industries including automobile, cement, conveyor equipment, wood, paper, steel and glass, general machine building, special engineering, petrochemicals and refinery, material handling, metals such as steel and aluminium, and packing machines. Relevant machines and applications include automatic guided vehicles, ingot casting machines, ladle cranes, cold rolled mills, hot strip mills, and blast furnaces.

question: Before recommending a WINKEL combined bearing, what should I ask the customer about their application?
answer: Based on the documented selection parameters, ask the customer about their required radial and axial load capacity (the bearing covers radial 5.23 kN to 59.20 kN and axial 1.68 kN to 18.50 kN), the operating temperature of their application (the bearing works from -20 degrees C to +80 degrees C), the required outer diameter and total width for their mounting, and their lubrication and duty cycle expectations.

question: How do I introduce Ewellix to a customer looking for linear motion solutions?
answer: Ewellix is the leading global manufacturer and supplier of linear motion solutions, incorporating state-of-the-art designs, components, and digital technology. They design, manufacture, and customise linear motion and linear actuators, including smart actuators, linear guides, and ball and roller screws for a variety of industrial applications.

question: What are the load, stroke, and temperature ratings of the Ewellix CAHB series linear actuator?
answer: The Ewellix CAHB series linear actuator has a push and pull load up to 10000 N and a maximum stroke from 50 mm to 700 mm. It is engineered for severe environments at temperatures from -40 to 85 degrees Celsius with a maximum duty cycle of 25%. It is virtually maintenance-free, self-locking up to 2 times the rated load, and rated up to IP69K.

question: What stroke and load capacity does the Ewellix CASM-100 high-performance actuator offer?
answer: The Ewellix CASM-100 high-performance actuator has a maximum stroke up to 2000 mm, a linear speed at no load up to 890 mm/s, a dynamic load capacity up to 106 kN, and a 100% duty cycle. The CASM range provides positioning precision of up to plus or minus 0.01 mm, has an IP54 sealing level, and complies with ISO-15552. It is a flexible replacement for hydraulic cylinders.

question: Brief me on Ewellix planetary roller screws before I meet a servo press customer.
answer: Ewellix planetary roller screws have a nominal diameter from 8 mm to 240 mm and a lead from 2 mm to 30 mm, with a basic dynamic load capacity up to 3994 kN and a basic static load capacity up to 23187 kN. They drive without roller recirculation for ultimate drive performance, are extremely robust and load-bearing, offer high speed and acceleration, and are durable, reliable, less noisy, and capable of high rotational speed. They suit applications such as spot welding, riveting, servo press, and hexapods.

question: I'm visiting a medical equipment customer. What Ewellix products can I pitch and where do they fit?
answer: For a medical equipment customer, pitch Ewellix lifting columns and actuators. The THG lifting column lifts medium loads up to 2000 N for imaging equipment, infant incubators, and radiant warmers. The TLT lifting column handles push loads up to 4000 N for surgical tables and physiotherapy devices. The CAMT linear actuator is maintenance-free with no oil leakage for surgical tables and procedure chairs, and the CAWD actuator suits surgical robotics and mobile C-arm/X-arm. These give smooth, precise motion for patient-facing equipment.

question: What is the push load and stroke of the Ewellix THG lifting column, and what is it used for?
answer: The Ewellix THG lifting column has a push load up to 2000 N, a stroke from 100 mm to 700 mm, a no-load linear speed up to 15 mm/s, and a 10% duty cycle. It is slim and compact, designed for off-center loads, and uses a DC motor with optional position feedback. It caters to the medical industry, with applications including imaging equipment, infant incubators, and radiant warmers.

question: Give me the background on LinMot and its maker for a customer introduction.
answer: LinMot linear motors are made by NTI AG, a renowned worldwide producer of tubular-style linear motors and linear motor systems. NTI AG was initially established in 1993 as part of the Sulzer Group and has been operating independently since 2000. Its product lineup includes the globally recognized brands LinMot for industrial linear motors and MagSpring for magnetic springs. NTI AG supplies its products in 80 countries worldwide.

question: What is the maximum stroke, force, and peak velocity of the LinMot P10 series linear motor?
answer: The LinMot Series P10 (3x400VAC) linear motor has a maximum stroke from 1770 mm to 2240 mm, a force from 892 N to 2720 N, and a peak velocity from 7.4 m/s to 11.1 m/s. It is used in printing presses, packaging and labeling, and wood, glass, and ceramic processing.

question: Brief me on the LinMot stainless steel linear motor for a food hygiene customer.
answer: The LinMot SSC stainless steel linear motors are constructed of stainless steel EN 1.4404/AISI 316 and designed for harsh environments with an emphasis on hygienic design. They are made without extra edges, corners, holes, or screw connections to prevent the buildup of dirt. The windings are completely coated in epoxy resin, shielding the copper filling and stator package from moisture and corrosion. They have a maximum stroke from 780 mm to 1530 mm and serve marine, medical and pharmaceutical, food, and automation industries.

question: A customer works in oil and gas with explosive atmospheres. Which LinMot motor should I pitch?
answer: Pitch the LinMot Explosion Proof linear motor. It is designed for the oil and gas industry and environments with explosive atmospheres. It has a maximum stroke from 860 mm to 980 mm, a force from 310 N to 721 N, and a velocity from 2.3 m/s to 3.4 m/s.

question: Which industries and applications does the LinMot P10 series serve that I can reference in a packaging pitch?
answer: The LinMot P10 series serves industries including food and beverage, pharmaceutical, automation and robotics, packaging and printing, aerospace and defence, and textile and printing. Its applications include printing presses, filling and sealing, packaging and labeling, and wood, glass, and ceramic processing.

question: What are the benefits of Warner Electric Clutch/Brake Modules (EM, UM, EUM) for a food line?
answer: Warner Electric's Unimodule Clutch/Brake modules (EM, UM, EUM) provide the ultimate in application versatility, from rapid cycling and accurate positioning to soft controlled starts and stops. They come completely pre-assembled, pre-aligned, and pre-burnished at the factory for maximum performance right out of the box.

question: A meat and poultry processor uses caustic washdown. What should I pitch?
answer: Pitch Warner Electric's all stainless steel clutches and brakes. Caustic washdown solutions can cause corrosion and eventual failure in food processing applications such as meat and poultry, so these units feature stainless steel bearings and stainless steel housing and are designed to handle the most hostile washdown, tough enough to perform 24/7.

question: Which crane and hoist machine types can I target with Warner Electric ERD brakes?
answer: Warner Electric ERD electrically released brakes apply across chain and wire rope hoists, gantry cranes, jib workshop cranes, monorail lifting systems, steel mill cranes, top slewing lifting cranes, traveling bridge cranes, and truck-mounted and crawler cranes.

question: What braking solution suits indoor and outdoor heavy duty steel mill cranes?
answer: For steel mill cranes, Warner Electric offers spring-operated / electromagnetic release brakes for indoor and outdoor heavy duty applications. Its ERD brakes provide reliable, cost-effective power-off load holding, deliver heavy-duty braking with no residual torque in the disengaged position, and are ideal for dynamic stopping when power is lost.

question: Which packaging machinery applications does Warner Electric serve?
answer: Warner Electric serves packaging machinery applications including blisterpacking, bottling and capping, carton and case packing, cleaning and sterilizing, filling, form fill seal, inspection, labeling, and palletizing.

question: What does Warner Electric recommend for indexing and positioning functions in packaging?
answer: For indexing, positioning, and backstopping functions, Warner Electric offers a complete line of wrap spring clutches and clutch/brakes. They are particularly well suited for these functions, with fast, repeatable, and positive action that provides identical cycling over a long life.
